codeReview.summary: The fix correctly scopes native-select Escape bypass state to the current interaction by clearing stale select tracking on non-Escape keydown and fresh pointer interactions, while preserving the immediate two-step Escape behavior needed for native popup dismissal followed by dashboard unwind. The updated Playwright coverage reopens the same select and verifies that the first Escape is native again before a second Escape closes dashboard UI, which matches the feature description and expected behavior.
